name: Before and After
description: Two images in one frame with a divider you move to compare them.

props.name: first
props.description: The image on the left of the divider. A string is used as an image URL; anything else is placed as it is and should fill its box.

props.name: second
props.description: The image on the right, clipped at the divider.

props.name: initial
props.description: Where the divider starts, as a percentage of the width from the left.

props.name: mode
props.description: Drag: press anywhere and drag to move the divider. Hover: the divider follows the pointer. Touch always drags.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Sweep the divider slowly back and forth until someone takes over. It holds while hovered or focused and stays off under reduced motion.

props.name: autoplayDuration
props.description: Milliseconds for one sweep from side to side.

props.name: labels
props.description: Small labels for the top corners, which fade as the divider passes over them. They also name the images and the divider for assistive technology.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the divider, which is a slider for assistive technology. Defaults to one built from labels.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the frame, which is 16:10 and full width by default. Also accepts every other prop of a div.
